precedence: Revision 5 governs implementation, admission and release gates. The scoped supplement adopts the selected feature requirements only; its explicit exclusions control over conflicting revision-9 text.

features.production_scope: V22 selector/alias/correspondence/coverage/reuse requirements; exact implementation and proof mappings remain unqualified. Existing admission checks continue unchanged.
features.prerequisites: Qualified pure judgments before production use; retained Git/blob profile first; explicit applicable retention/publication/recovery bridges.
features.acceptance: Exact historical resolution; no incorrect successor attachment; honest coverage; scoped/revocable aliases; typed coordinates; preserved legacy assessment/freshness; complete repeated-workflow measurement.

features.prerequisites: Qualified ledger, atomic intake, ownership/effect protocols and immutable prepared views. Plain run show precedes Ratatui.
features.acceptance: Idempotent/conflict-aware start; exact session recovery; reader noninterference; coherent historical cuts; no stale green receipts; honest unknown effects; installed WSL comparison and narrow-terminal behavior.
features.excluded_from_examples: Universal Lean-instance prerequisite labels; configured driver activation; provider effects.

features.prerequisites: Qualified citation binding and exact reader; P01O/WF24 before native storage integration; scoped lexical baseline before conditional hybrid admission.
features.acceptance: Kind-qualified exact bindings; authorized ranking inputs and outputs; current access/retention checks; explicit omissions; no inferred absence or authority; immutable index/query profiles; incident and mixed-kind held-out evaluations.

deferred.rule: Not adopted, including repeated requirements in any other plan, stage, example or screen.
Original definitions retained for traceability, not activated or silently repurposed.
Imported candidate instructions do not replace the current root instructions or revision-5 dependency order.

qualification_policy.feature_gates: Before enabling these features, integrate scoped requirement/theorem/caller/scenario mappings and actual receipt producers into current tooling. Revision-5 aggregation alone does not qualify the additions.
qualification_policy.proofs: Proof-first and existing Lean/Verus/TLC/TLAPS obligations remain; no existing guard or required proof is weakened.
qualification_policy.evidence_reuse: No historical receipt or completed obligation is renewed by planning adoption.
qualification_policy.storage: Known P01O/WF24 retained-branch relocation blocker remains; no rerun, workaround or fallback.

investigation.scope: Package, synthetic examples, standalone Lean module and external prover replay only; failed attempts retained; no product qualification.

external_prover.scope: Two-line refutation and genuine certificate/evidence negative controls, no Writfold runtime or language implementation. Separate IR/interpreter/REPL design remains discussion only.
